text:
incident-bot: Paging: runtime.p95 > 1.2s across canary wave 3 (region-us-east-2). Error spike: 5xx up 12%. Trigger: kernel fallback to generic allocator on node pool g4b-canary-3.

sara: oncall taking. seeing the alert, pulling up dashboards now. link: https://console.redwood.internal/d/latency/canary-wave-3

kevin: i can see throughput dropping ~30% on canary pods that hit fallback. batch window collapsed to 8ms vs expected 35ms -> lots of tiny microbatches.

kevin: KV miss rate also spiked, looks like prefetch_v2 changed allocation pattern -> thrashing. kernel fallback + cache churn = slowtail.

eva: confirmed logs show `kernel_select: fallback(generic) at 2026-03-17T20:07:10Z` on ~40% of requests.

raj: which deploy caused this? any release id?

deploy-bot: Release 2026.03.17.WAVE-12 deployed at 20:05:42 UTC to canary-wave-3. Jobs: model-serving:v2 -> prefetch_v2=enabled.

sara: ok. two immediate mitigations: 1) flip prefetch_v2 off (feature flag) 2) abort wave-12 rollout and start rollback of affected canary pods. both low blast radius. agree?

kev in thread: +1 to ff off, rolling back now if we can do it safely. need CS to confirm customer impact before global rollback.

cs_team: we're seeing two enterprise tenants with elevated 504s and a small set of API errors (50–100 requests/min). notified account teams.

kevin: command to flip: `./ffctl set prefetch_v2 false --env canary-wave-3`

sara: running ffctl now.

incident-bot: Action: feature-flag change requested by sara. Shard: canary-wave-3.

deploy-bot: FF toggle executed: prefetch_v2=false on 12 nodes in canary-wave-3. Confirming propagation.

kevin: also executing rollback: `deployctl rollback --release WAVE-12 --scope canary-wave-3 --graceful`

raj: monitoring metrics: p95 trending down from 1.35s -> 0.48s after FF flip (first 90s). throughput recovering. KV miss rate falling.

cs_team: customer impact decreased after ~2 minutes. account owners updated.

sara: good. setting incident status -> mitigated. keeping the thread open for handoff. we need a 1:1 postmortem and action items: revert safe flags, tweak kernel selector tests, add a canary probe for kernel fallback, and a runbook for ff flips.

kevin: logging owner for follow-up: kevin (root cause kernel selector + prefetch_v2 interaction). eva to lead the postmortem writeup.

eva: ack, i'll start the draft and include timeline + sampling of affected calls.

raj: handing off to next on-call @ 21:10 UTC. sara, please post any outstanding notes.

sara: handoff note: mitigated by FF off + canary rollback. customer impact limited to 2 tenants; no broad outages. watch p95 and 5xx for 30m. if p95 creeps >0.9s, escalate to SRE lead.

incident-bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026-314 created. Severity: Sev2.

sara: Thanks team. postmortem ETA 48h. closing slack incident channel pickup in 30m unless new alerts. :white_check_mark:
